visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera focuses on a hand with blue gradient manicured nails holding a light blue, crab-shaped coin purse featuring the Louis Vuitton monogram. The background is a brightly lit luxury store interior with a white coffee cup holder and other accessories on a white counter. (2) A second hand enters from the top left, presenting a lime green turtle-shaped coin purse. The hand holding the green turtle opens its yellow-lined interior to the camera, revealing its hollow structure. (3) The camera shifts to a close-up of a white cup wrapped in a brown leather Louis Vuitton monogram sleeve, complete with a gold-colored straw protruding from the lid. (4) The final phase shows both the light blue crab and the lime green turtle purses side-by-side on the glass display surface, with another grey-toned crab purse visible in the blurred background. The camera moves slightly to show both objects together.
